clauses.why: The verses say Bilhah bore him to Jacob and Rachel named him after her wrestlings; 'was born to Jacob' is fine but 'named by Rachel' is supported, though 'after her wrestlings with her sister' is a stated reason; only wording needs tightening.
clauses.english: was born to Jacob and named by Rachel, who had wrestled with her sister
clauses.ukr: народився Якову, і Рахіль назвала його так після боротьби з сестрою
clauses.deu: wurde Jakob geboren und von Rahel benannt
clauses.spa: nació a Jacob y fue nombrado por Rachêl tras luchar con su hermana
